title: Trump says US to ’guide’ stranded ships through Strait of Hormuz
byline: President Donald Trump has said that the US will help guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz from Monday.

title: Comments on court cases at the May Day rally are common knowledge – Nalinda
byline: It is “common knowledge” that court dates in several cases have already been fixed, Minister Nalinda Jayatissa said, responding to remarks made at recent May Day rallies of the National Freedom Front (NPP) that more cases would be taken up and decisions delivered in the coming months.

title: Sri Lanka still in talks with China to purchase fuel under G2G deal
byline: Sri Lanka is still having discussions with China to purchase fuel under a government to government agreement at market rates, Ports, Civil Aviation and Energy Minister Anura Karunathilake said yesterday.

title: Did the Finance Ministry ignore prior warning?
byline: The US $ 2.5 million cyber theft has taken place at the Finance Ministry despite prior warning about such suspicious transactions by some external parties, according to what transpired during the meeting of the Committee on Public Finance (COPF) in the parliamentary complex last week.

title: Transport authorities under fire as fuel costs rise
byline: A controversial standoff has emerged in Sri Lanka’s transport sector, with key authorities and unions refusing to revise fares despite a fresh fuel price hike, raising questions about transparency, political pressure, and who ultimately bears the cost.

title: Indian Navy Submarine docks at Colombo Port
byline: INS Sindhukesari, a submarine serving in the Indian Navy, arrived at the port of Colombo to undertake Operational Turnarounds yesterday.

title: Man injured in Katugastota shooting
byline: A 28-year-old man was hospitalized with gunshot wounds following an incident in the Gohagoda area of Katugastota early Monday morning. The victim, identified as a supervisor in the cleaning department at the Kandy National Hospital, is currently receiving treatment at the same institution.

title: Sri Lanka becomes hotspot for foreign-linked online fraud operations
byline: Sri Lanka has emerged as a growing hotspot for foreign-linked online fraud operations, with authorities reporting a sharp increase in cybercrime networks run by foreign nationals across the island.

title: President accused of politicising judicial process: Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa today alleged that President Anura Kumara Dissanayake was attempting to influence judicial matters through political platforms, claiming decisions were being signalled during May Day events linked to the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP).

title: Poland to complain to EU over alleged fraud in Sri Lanka’s e-passport personalization tender procedure
byline: The Polish government is contemplating lodging a complaint with the EU over an allegedly fraudulent e-passport personalization tender procedure by the Sri Lankan government after the Polish Security Printing Works (PWPW) and six other international bidders were rejected without any credible explanations.

title: CID seeks FBI assistance into US $2.5 Million cyber heist
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has sought the assistance of the United States’ Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to widen the probe into the cyber fraud that resulted in the loss of US$2.5 million from the national Treasury, a senior officer told the Daily Mirror.

title: Tamil Nadu election results: MK Stalin trails in Kolathur seat, his DMK ahead In early leads
byline: The counting for the high-stakes three-cornered Tamil Nadu Assembly election has begun. The state, known as the citadel of Dravidian politics for over 50 years, with a binary politics dominated by the DMK and AIADMK, could be in for winds of change.

title: Three die after suspected hantavirus outbreak aboard Atlantic cruise ship
byline: A suspected hantavirus outbreak linked to an Atlantic cruise voyage has left three people dead, while a British tourist is being treated in hospital in South Africa.

title: Failure to raise alcohol taxes increases consumption: Fact Sheet
byline: A recent fact sheet has highlighted the growing economic and social consequences of not consistently increasing alcohol taxes over the past two years, pointing to rising consumption levels and mounting pressure on Sri Lanka’s healthcare system.

title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
byline: Three people have died after a suspected hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean, the World Health Organization (WHO) has told the BBC.

title: Dansala registration begins for Vesak, Poson; Health guidelines issued
byline: The Sri Lanka Public Health Inspectors’ Association announced that registration of dansalas for the upcoming Vesak and Poson festivals has commenced islandwide.

title: ’’Cricket doesn’t have to be left-wing’’: Bimal on Eran’s appointment
byline: Minister Bimal Rathnayake defended the appointment of Eran Wickramaratne as Chairman of the Cricket Restructuring Committee, while dismissing concerns over political differences and stressing the need for capable leadership in reviving the sport.

title: Iran’s army warns all ships must coordinate with its forces in Hormuz or face attack
byline: The Iranian army has said “the security of the Strait of Hormuz is in the hands of the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran and that any safe passage and navigation in any situation will be carried out in coordination with the armed forces”.

title: US transfers crew of captured Iranian ship to Pakistan
byline: A spokesperson for US Central Command (CENTCOM) has told the ABC broadcaster that crew members of the M/V Touska, which was captured in the Gulf of Oman last month, have been taken to Pakistan for repatriation to Iran.

title: A Letter from Chinese Ambassador to Young People of Sri Lanka
byline: Amid a period of profound changes unseen in a century, a nation’s future increasingly depends on the values, mindset and creativity of its younger generation. In Sri Lanka, I am often moved by the talent and vitality of the young people here, and I can genuinely sense their affinity for China and their enthusiasm for deepening exchanges and cooperation between our two nations:

title: Ravi K calls for independent forensic probe into NDB fraud
byline: Democratic National Alliance (DNA) MP Ravi Karunanayake has called on President and Finance Minister Anura Dissanayake to initiate an independent forensic investigation into the alleged fraud at National Development Bank PLC (NDB), citing serious concerns over regulatory lapses and systemic weaknesses in financial oversight.

title: Treasury Secretary should be summoned before privilege committee: Dayasiri
byline: Opposition MP Dayasiri Jayasekara is to take up in Parliament this week the dollars 2.5 million theft where he is to propose summoning of Treasury Secretary Dr. Harshana Suriyapperuma before the Committee on Parliamentary Privileges.

title: Govt. says Vesak Poya day was determined by Mahanayake Theras
byline: In the wake of certain people including some Buddhist monks raising concerns over changing the date of Vesak, the government yesterday reiterated that Vesak Poya was rescheduled for May 30 on the request of the Mahanayake Theras.

title: Early trends show big lead for Vijay’s TVK in Tamil Nadu
byline: Two hours since the counting of votes began and early trends show a big win for actor Vijay’s new party Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK). In Tamil Nadu, where votes were cast for 234 seats, a tug of war is playing out between TVK, currently leading in 85 seats and the AIADMK-led alliance leading in 77 seats. The ruling DMK in alliance with Congress and DMDK has taken a third spot.

title: Hot days, wet evenings; mixed weather forecast for Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lanka will experience unsettled weather conditions with both hot daytime temperatures and afternoon showers affecting several parts of the country in the coming days.

title: Trump says US to ’guide’ stranded ships through Strait of Hormuz
byline: President Donald Trump has said that the US will help guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz from Monday.

title: Iran prevents entry of U.S. warships into Strait of Hormuz
byline: Iran’s navy said on Monday it had prevented the entry of enemy warships into the Strait of Hormuz by issuing a “swift and decisive warning”, according to state TV.

title: Online seat booking system launched for long-distance bus passengers
byline: A new website enabling long-distance passengers to reserve bus seats in advance through an online booking system was officially introduced by the government, aiming to ease travel and improve efficiency in public transport.

title: Vietnamese President to visit Sri Lanka
byline: The President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam, Tô Lâm, will undertake a State Visit to Sri Lanka from May 7 to 8, 2026.

title: IRGC issues new map of Strait of Hormuz under its control
byline: Iran’s Islamic ⁠Revolutionary ⁠Guard Corps (IRGC) has published a new map of ⁠areas in the Strait of Hormuz ⁠under the control of its navy, the Fars News Agency reports.

title: Kerala Assembly election: No Left govt left in India for first time in 50 years
byline: With the CPI(M)-led Left Democratic Front (LDF) losing Kerala Assembly elections, no Left government will be left in India for the first time in 50 years.

title: Sri Lanka, Maldives sign seven MoUs to boost cooperation
byline: Sri Lanka and the Maldives today signed seven Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) covering a range of key sectors, following the official state ceremony to welcome Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu.

title: Heated exchange as MP Ramanathan Archchuna refuses life jacket on boat trip
byline: A routine boat trip turned into a scene of high tension recently when MP Ramanathan Archchuna reportedly refused to wear a mandatory life jacket, leading to a fierce confrontation with fellow passengers and boat operators.

title: At least 12 wounded after Oklahoma party shooting
byline: US authorities responded to reports of gunfire at about 9pm local time on Sunday at a gathering of young people near Arcadia Lake, Edmond Police Department spokesperson Emily Ward said.

title: Dengue cases rise, 12 deaths reported in 2026
byline: Health authorities have reported a surge in dengue cases across the country, with 12 dengue-related deaths recorded so far in 2026.

title: Two major turmeric hauls hidden in chilli imports seized by customs
byline: In two separate operations, today, officers of the Customs Prevention Division seized large stocks of undeclared turmeric that had been concealed among imported dried chillies.

title: Gammanpila demands fresh post-mortem over Finance Ministry official’s death
byline: While rejecting the post-mortem report on the death of Ranga Nishantha, an Assistant Director at the Ministry of Finance, Pivithuru Hela Urumaya leader Udaya Gammanpila has called for a second post-mortem to be conducted by a new, independent panel.

title: Sri Lanka appoints representative to Palestine equivalent to ambassador
byline: Sri Lanka has appointed M. Fauser as Sri Lanka’s representative to Palestine, equivalent in status to an ambassador, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said.

title: UAE says Iran fired drones at oil tanker in Hormuz
byline: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) says Iran launched two suicide drones at a tanker affiliated with its Abu Dhabi National Oil Company in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: WhatsApp video scam targets Sri Lankans; victims blackmailed for ransom
byline: Several complaints have been lodged with the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team (CERT) in recent days over a new WhatsApp-based video scam that has reportedly targeted Sri Lankans, with operations believed to be linked to India.

title: Russia offers AI health support, advanced medical training for Sri Lankan doctors
byline: Health and Mass Media Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa and Russian Health Minister Mikhail Murashko held talks today on strengthening Sri Lanka’s primary healthcare system and expanding the use of modern technology, including artificial intelligence, in the health sector.

title: US denies Iranian claim it struck American warship
byline: US Central Command (Centcom) denies that one of its warships has been struck by two Iranian missiles.

title: Netherlands marks Remembrance Day in Colombo with tribute to war victims
byline: The Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands today commemorated Remembrance Day with a solemn ceremony at the Commonwealth War Graves section of the Jawatta Cemetery, honouring Dutch victims of war buried in Sri Lanka.

title: SriLankan Airlines wins two top South Asia awards at PAX 2026
byline: SriLankan Airlines has secured two major accolades in the South Asia category at the PAX International Readership Awards 2026 held recently in Hamburg, Germany.

title: Former SLPP MP nabbed over Rs. 21.3 mn Romania job scam
byline: A former Member of Parliament affiliated with the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) has been arrested over an alleged large-scale foreign employment scam involving more than Rs. 21.3 million, The Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE) said.
